checks.statement: Choose flat or wavy shape to suit the product tone; account for the wavy shape increasing component height and becoming less visible at very small sizes.
checks.condition: When choosing indicator shape.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Active indicator: Choose flat or wavy shape to suit the product tone; account for the wavy shape increasing component height and

checks.statement: Choose no indicator for waits under 200ms, a loading indicator for 200ms–5s, and a progress indicator for waits over 5s; for very long work, consider letting people leave while it completes.
checks.condition: When selecting process feedback by expected wait time.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Usage: Choose no indicator for waits under 200ms, a loading indicator for 200ms–5s, and a progress indicator for wait

checks.statement: Expose a progressbar role and an accessible label identifying the process and affected content, such as loading an article or refreshing a page.
checks.condition: When exposing progress to assistive technology.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Labeling elements: Expose a progressbar role and an accessible label identifying the process and affected content, such as loadin

checks.statement: For a button action, a circular indicator may show activity; use a flat shape in very small buttons, match indicator color to icon or label text, remove the track, and avoid applying indicators to every button in a list.
checks.condition: When showing button-level progress.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Progress indicators in buttons: For a button action, a circular indicator may show activity; use a flat shape in very small buttons, match ind

checks.statement: Keep circular indicators between 24dp and 240dp and reserve the largest sizes for large or extra-large windows. Linear indicators should span their container width, not be used in elements under 40dp, and have at least 4dp end padding.
checks.condition: When sizing indicators responsively.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Large screens: Keep circular indicators between 24dp and 240dp and reserve the largest sizes for large or extra-large windows

checks.statement: Keep the same linear or circular variant for the same process throughout the product; use linear at a container edge and circular centered in an element.
checks.condition: When choosing and reusing indicator variants.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Usage: Keep the same linear or circular variant for the same process throughout the product; use linear at a containe

checks.statement: Inset a linear progress indicator 4dp from the screen edge.
checks.condition: When a linear indicator is inset from the screen edge.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements prose or table: Inset a linear progress indicator 4dp from the screen edge.

checks.statement: Maintain at least 3:1 contrast for the active indicator; when integrated in another component, match its icon or label color and remove the track.
checks.condition: When selecting indicator colors.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Interaction & style: Maintain at least 3:1 contrast for the active indicator; when integrated in another component, match its icon

checks.statement: Mirror linear progress indicators for RTL; circular indicators do not need mirroring.
checks.condition: When rendering progress in RTL.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Right-to-left languages: Mirror linear progress indicators for RTL; circular indicators do not need mirroring.

checks.statement: Place linear indicators along the loading container edge (or its changing edge) and circular indicators centered on the loading container or page. Use one page-level indicator for page-wide loading.
checks.condition: When placing progress feedback.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Placement: Place linear indicators along the loading container edge (or its changing edge) and circular indicators center

checks.statement: People using assistive technology must be able to reach the progress indicator and understand the progress it communicates.
checks.condition: When exposing progress feedback.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated the explicit Use cases instruction: People using assistive technology must be able to reach the progress indicator and understand the progress it

checks.statement: Determinate and indeterminate behavior, fixed 4dp track thickness, and flat shape are available in M3 and M3 Expressive; configurable thickness and wavy shape are M3 Expressive additions.
checks.condition: When choosing progress-indicator configurations by design generation.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the specific Configurations rule: Determinate and indeterminate behavior, fixed 4dp track thickness, and flat shape are available in M3 and M3 E

checks.statement: Linear and circular progress indicator variants are available in both M3 and M3 Expressive.
checks.condition: When exposing progress-indicator variant availability.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the specific Variants rule: Linear and circular progress indicator variants are available in both M3 and M3 Expressive.

checks.statement: Retain the linear stop indicator whenever the track has less than 3:1 contrast with its container or surrounding surface.
checks.condition: When rendering a linear determinate indicator.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Interaction & style: Retain the linear stop indicator whenever the track has less than 3:1 contrast with its container or surroundi

checks.statement: Use the same progress-indicator configuration for all instances of the same process.
checks.condition: When the same process appears in multiple places.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated the explicit Progress indicators instruction: Use the same progress-indicator configuration for all instances of the same process.

checks.statement: Show the active indicator as soon as progress begins; at very low percentages it should appear as a dot.
checks.condition: When progress has just begun.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Active indicator: Show the active indicator as soon as progress begins; at very low percentages it should appear as a dot.

checks.statement: Use determinate progress only when progress and wait time are known, and represent measured progress accurately; otherwise use indeterminate and switch to determinate when information becomes available.
checks.condition: When progress information is known or changes.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Usage: Use determinate progress only when progress and wait time are known, and represent measured progress accuratel

checks.statement: Use one indicator for a group of loading items rather than one per activity, unless items are activated independently.
checks.condition: When multiple items are loading.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Usage: Use one indicator for a group of loading items rather than one per activity, unless items are activated indepe

checks.statement: Use the 4dp stop indicator for linear determinate progress; it is not used for indeterminate or circular indicators. It is required when the track contrast is below 3:1 against its container or surrounding surface.
checks.condition: When rendering a linear determinate indicator.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Stop indicator: Use the 4dp stop indicator for linear determinate progress; it is not used for indeterminate or circular indic

checks.statement: For wavy indicators, height is the overall container height, amplitude runs from the center of the resting position to the center of a peak, and wavelength is the distance between adjacent peaks. Thicker variants are sample measurements to adjust for the use case, not fixed defaults.
checks.condition: When using a wavy indicator or selecting a thicker variant.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated explicit measurement definitions and the source caveat on thicker variants.
